title: The Last Day
text:
The classroom looks smaller than it did in January. The walls are bare now, the posters taken down, and our names have already been peeled off the lockers at the back.
We spent the morning signing one another's shirts. Somebody wrote a joke on my sleeve that I will not be able to explain to my mother.
Mrs Nathan did not give us a speech. She simply stood at the door as we filed out, and said each of our names as we passed, the way she had done every morning for two years.
At the gate, we promised to meet up in December. Some of us will. Most of us, I think, will not.
I turned around once before the bus came. The classroom light was already off.
